noCancellation: Passengers cannot cancel bookings. If the operator cancels the trip, the full paid amount is refunded.
paymentNote: You will be sent to the secure payment page. Your booking is confirmed after successful payment.
expired: The payment deadline has passed. Search again and choose available seats.
noBookingsText: Start by finding a trip, then choose your preferred seat.
checkoutUnavailable: Online payment is currently unavailable. Check the recorded payment status above.

historyNotes.all: All your bookings, ordered from newest to oldest.
historyNotes.upcoming: Active bookings for trips that have not departed, including bookings awaiting payment or confirmation.
historyNotes.past: Confirmed bookings for trips whose departure time has passed.
historyNotes.expired: Bookings whose payment deadline has passed. Payments still being verified remain under All.
historyNotes.cancelled: Bookings for trips cancelled by the operator. Open a booking to check its refund status.

historyEmptyNote: Choose another category to see your other bookings.
historyEnd: No more bookings on this page
historyEndNote: Return to the first page to see the latest bookings in this category.
